prompt: Norwegian folk-orchestral, anthemic, majestic, sweeping strings, hardanger fiddle, powerful male vocals, proud, patriotic, cinematic production, nature-inspired, scenic, folk-pop blend
lyrics:
[Intro]
(Orchestral swell with hardanger fiddle)

[Verse 1]
Where the North Sea meets the rugged shore
And the fjords open wide like an ancient door
From the peaks of Lysefjord to the salty breeze
We stand as one, beneath the towering trees

[Chorus]
Oh Rogaland, land of the golden west
In your emerald valleys, our spirits find rest
With a heart like the ocean, a soul like the stone
The pride of our fathers, the place we call home

[Verse 2]
From the streets of Stavanger to the highland plain
Through the summer sun and the winter rain
The strength of the sailor, the toil of the hand
Building a future in this beautiful land

[Chorus]
Oh Rogaland, land of the golden west
In your emerald valleys, our spirits find rest
With a heart like the ocean, a soul like the stone
The pride of our fathers, the place we call home

[Bridge]
(Instrumental build-up, cinematic strings and fiddle)

[Chorus]
Oh Rogaland, land of the golden west
In your emerald valleys, our spirits find rest
With a heart like the ocean, a soul like the stone
The pride of our fathers, the place we call home

[Outro]
Our home, our pride
Rogaland...
(Final orchestral chord, fade out)
